'''Illumi-panels''', also known as '''illumination banks''' or '''lumipanels''',<ref name="ODSTM">{{JournalCite|10|Only Droids Serve the Maker}}</ref> were specialized sources of light that employed a large number of floodlights to illuminate a wide area. Smaller versions of that device were called '''illumi-strips'''.
